hero.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Asset type: main product photograph for a Russian board-game landing page.
Image 1 is the edit target: the closer photo of the handmade Wine Crocodile box, the fan of cards, and a wine bottle. Image 2 supports the exact box and card artwork. Image 3 supports the full bottle proportions and composition.
Retouch and recompose these real objects into one polished, photorealistic editorial product photograph, landscape 4:3. Keep the distinctive real white cardboard box, its wine-glass-and-grapes illustration, fan of illustrated cards, printed Cyrillic labels, and the real Riesling bottle. Keep the physical handmade paper texture and honest proportions. Close and tidy the box lid. Preserve the existing product identity rather than inventing a different board game.
Replace only the distracting room background with a softly lit warm ivory plaster backdrop and a clean warm pale wood or limestone tabletop. Remove keyboard, wires, curtains, dust and clutter. Improve exposure, white balance, fine detail and soft contact shadows. Warm natural window light from the upper left; sophisticated, inviting, tactile atmosphere. No new objects, no people, no hands, no additional glasses, no grapes as physical props.
Composition: box standing near the center-left, cards fanned in front, bottle behind at the right, all comfortably inside the image with breathing room. The game box and cards are the main subjects, the bottle is secondary. Do not crop the game box or the card fan. Preserve real card illustrations and existing readable print. Main box text must remain verbatim: "ВИННЫЙ", "крокодил", "30 КАРТОЧЕК", "СЛОВА", "ЖЕСТЫ", "ВМЕСТЕ". No promotional typography over the scene, no invented logos, no watermark, no fake product claims.

detail.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: secondary close-up product photo for the Wine Crocodile board-game landing page.
Image 1 is the edit target, showing the real handmade box and fan of cards on a cluttered dark desk. Image 2 is a lighting and tabletop reference from the already retouched main photo.
Make a polished, photorealistic close-up of the same box and cards. Remove the keyboard, wires, electronics, clutter, dust and dark desk. Use the warm pale limestone tabletop and ivory backdrop from Image 2, with matching soft natural window light and contact shadows. Tidy and close the box lid. Keep the paper texture, exact existing game design, illustrated cards and Cyrillic typography. Do not turn the handmade prototype into glossy plastic or a different commercial product. The game is "ВИННЫЙ крокодил", with "30 КАРТОЧЕК"; preserve those words and the real card artwork.
Composition: landscape 4:3, slightly elevated angle, the box behind the fanned cards, the entire fan visible with space around it. No bottle in this close-up, no extra objects, no new text, no watermark. Keep card titles recognizable; no invented text or extra graphic symbols.
